about_the_game:
Traitors is a social deduction shooter set in a procedurally generated space station, where the environment changes every round.

The Crewmates will try to repair the station's communication equipment and call for evacuation, while the outnumbered Traitors will use special tools to stop that from happening. Whatever your role, work fast, because the oxygen is running low!

The game always starts at the Hangar, where the map potentially branches out to three wings. Rest of the rooms are chosen at random. Some rooms have unique properties, like vending machines, electrical controls or environmental dangers that Traitors can leverage.

Find the locked door to Communications Room using a GPS, a map or pure luck. Craft the correct keycard at the office in Hangar using resin and the code on the locked door. Repair the communications equipment using the required items, push the red button and hurry back to the Hangar, a rescue ship is arriving and it won't wait too long!

The map scales in size as the player count increases. 

Immersive proximity chat makes everyone sound like they are part of the world. Player voices, gunshots and other audible actions get occluded behind walls and solid objects.

Pistols, rifles, shotguns, melee weapons and grenade launchers. Firearms and valuable equipment can be found in locked safes. Find a key first!

Collect cash from containers, deposit it using a Deposit Machine and use Terminals to order equipment such as Teleport tablets, GPSs, Flashlights, Keys, Oxygen, Medkits and Ammo.

Traitors may use credits to purchase special equipment with instant delivery. This includes time bombs, daggers, disguisers, cleaning kits, mines and more!

The spectate UI makes it easy to follow the action even when the map get big. Two different camera modes allow you to easily sit back and spectate or frame your own cinematic shots.

Hosts can customize the match settings, including the roles, loot and procedural generation rules. We would like to make sure your group can play the way the want to, so let us know if there's a setting you'd like to see.

A breakdown of key features:

  • 4-12 players.

  • Procedurally generated map with 20 unique rooms.

  • High replayability.

  • Proximity chat.

  • A percentage of players will be Traitors, trying to kill rest of the Crewmates.

  • Psycho Killer and Sheriff roles.

  • The map, objective count and loot scale with player count.

  • Gain access to the Communications room and firearms by 3D printing keycards.

  • Call for evacuation by repairing the station's radio equipment. The items needed for the repairs will be scattered around the station.

  • Refill your personal oxygen tank at the Oxygen Generator in hangar. When the generator eventually runs out of power, you will have to find or purchase more oxygen to stay alive.

  • Hosts can customize the server rules, ranging from role and round specific to procedural generation settings.

Does not feature a text chat, requires a microphone to play!

Join our Discord!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains first person player versus player firearm and melee combat with blood. Does not contain gore.
